additional_info.subject: Request from RC for I&C Support
additional_info.body:
Hi Reetesh,
Hope you are doing well.
I left this booth at 2:20 am trying to make the charging point ready but without success as we have an event at 9 am.
Before adding the dispenser, the EVC was showing green after adding both turns white.
I can notice an
error flag that the PLC on the dispenser is on stop
but I have checked physically and it is showing no error.
What support is required; Either
to delete the dispenser and make the Si-D green and I will switch off the dispenser.
Or
Try to adjust both dispenser and Si-D to show ready.
Please note that I had a word with Sousa earlier and agreed that PO can be placed for remote support if it is the case.
So please consider the above as a commitment from the region to pay for remote services support.
Thanks for your understanding.
